title: Crazy Taxi
text:
Crazy Taxi is a video game developed by Sega AM3 and published by Sega. The game was first released in arcades in 1999 and was ported to the Sega Dreamcast in 2000. Subsequently, it has been brought to the Sony PlayStation 2 and Nintendo GameCube in 2001; and then Windows and Game Boy Advance in 2002. A port to Sony PSP called Crazy Taxi: Fare Wars was released August 9, 2007. Crazy Taxi is the first game in the  series.
